intent: B2 Slice 3: Playwright pins for sandboxed HTML preview + CSP violation detector + shipped-template compat matrix
notes: Added `tests/test_dashboard_ui/test_html_preview.py` — 13 Playwright pins locking the B2 sandboxed-HTML-preview contract end-to-end. Function-scoped `csp_violation_listener` fixture (per r8 §M2 — pytest-playwright's `context` is function-scoped) installs a `securitypolicyviolation` DOM event listener via `context.add_init_script` on every per-test context so both the liveness pin and every compat pin capture violations on the exact context they run against.

`test_apply_response_headers_unchanged_by_b2` — H1 seam invariant. Source-grep asserts B1's `apply_response_headers` body still contains its four shipped `send_header` calls and does NOT emit `Content-Security-Policy` from within itself (the CSP seam is the dedicated `apply_html_csp_headers` helper).
`test_html_response_missing_sec_fetch_dest_gets_external_csp` — L2 pin. `urllib.request` GET (no `Sec-Fetch-Dest`) → external CSP with leading `sandbox allow-scripts;`.
`test_html_response_vary_header` — M1 pin. Both embedded (Sec-Fetch-Dest: iframe) and external requests carry `Vary: Sec-Fetch-Dest`.
`test_html_response_embedded_csp_variant` / `test_html_response_external_csp_variant` — CSP directive contents pinned per r14 §4.1 (no `'unsafe-eval'`); external prepends `sandbox allow-scripts;`.
`test_non_html_response_has_no_csp` — non-HTML `/raw/` responses (e.g. `hero.png`) do NOT get CSP or Vary; B2 headers are HTML-only.

`test_compat_urls_use_canonical_namespace_prefixes` — r14 §M1 static guard. Line-by-line source scan asserts no test URL uses `source/gator-command/` or `source/.gator/` alias prefixes. Runtime-constructed forbidden literals avoid self-reference.
